title: Landing page
note: Hero, borrowing pillars and calls to action for signed-out visitors.

title: Sign in
note: Single sign-in for students, librarians and superlibrarians. Role is detected from the account.

title: Student registration
note: Gmail-only registration with simulated email confirmation.

title: Verify email
note: Simulated confirmation link via the floating Demo Mailbox.

title: Forgot password
note: Sends a simulated reset link to the demo mailbox.

title: Reset password
note: Verifies the simulated token and sets a new password.

title: Student dashboard
note: Loans on the left, catalog suggestions stacked on the right.

title: Browse catalog
note: Search, filters and availability-aware request buttons.

title: Book detail
note: Single-copy detail with availability, rules and request action.

title: My loans
note: Pending requests sit above active and returned loan history.

title: My fines
note: Outstanding balance, simulated payment and fine history.

title: Profile & settings
note: Editable details, password entry point and demo data reset.

title: Librarian dashboard
note: Overdue shelf on the left, four operation shortcuts stacked on the right.

title: Borrow requests
note: Approve or decline student requests; the copy changes status only on approval.

title: Manage books
note: One row per physical copy, with loan state and safe delete rules.

title: Borrow & return
note: Desk-issued loans and returns with overdue estimates.

title: Students
note: Directory of borrowers with loan usage and unpaid balances.

title: Fines & payments
note: Collect, waive or issue a fine; overdue charges are created on return.

title: Superlibrarian dashboard
note: Librarian accounts on the left, oversight shortcuts on the right.

title: Librarian accounts
note: Create, edit and remove staff accounts. New accounts must change the temporary password.

title: First sign-in password change
note: Mandatory password update after a librarian receives a temporary credential.
